hindi.text: Namaste, aap kaise hain aaj?
Kya main aapki madad kar sakta hoon?
Dhanyavad.
Theek hai.
Mera naam Zarax hai aur main aapka AI assistant hoon.
Aapki appointment kal teen baje scheduled hai.
Hamare platform par aap apni awaaz clone kar sakte hain aur phir usi awaaz mein jawab pa sakte hain.
Is mahine ki report mein unhone bataya ki company ne naya investment kiya hai.
Pratigya aur pratibaddh vyakti ne pratirodh ka saamna kiya.
Vigyaan aur takneek ke kshetra mein bharat ne bahut pragati ki hai.
Aapka order number paanch char teen do ek hai.
Aaj paanch September do hazaar chhabbis hai.
Kya aapne apna phone number confirm kar diya?
Aap kaun si bhasha mein baat karna chahte hain?
Aapki request process ho rahi hai, please wait karein.
Zarax mein aapka swagat hai. Behtar seva ke liye ek dabayein.
नमस्ते, आप कैसे हैं आज?
मेरा नाम ज़ारैक्स है, मैं आपका AI असिस्टेंट हूँ।
Spasht awaaz mein bolein taaki samajh mein aaye.
Subah ka waqt sabse accha hota hai kaam karne ke liye.

english.text: Thank you for calling Zarax. How may I assist you?
Your appointment has been confirmed for tomorrow at three PM.
We are working on improving our AI voice platform to support multiple Indian languages including Hindi and Hinglish.
Your order number is one two three four five six.
Can you help me find the nearest hospital?
The meeting has been rescheduled to Friday morning.
First, please confirm your name. Then, provide your date of birth.
The quarterly earnings report demonstrates a fifteen percent increase in revenue.

hinglish.text: Hello bro, aaj market ka kya scene hai?
Namaste! Aapka account balance check karna hai kya?
Please hold karo, main abhi connect karta hoon.
Aapki call important hai, please wait karo.
Sorry yaar, ek minute mein aapko callback milega.
Aapka internet connection slow hai, please router restart karo.
Bhai, aaj meeting cancel ho gayi, koi tension nahi.
Your order successfully place ho gaya hai, delivery kal hogi.
Main kal office mein present karunga the quarterly report.
Yaar, kya tum mujhe help kar sakte ho is problem ko solve karne mein?

cross_language_voice_test.text: Hello, this is my voice. I am testing the voice identity system.
Namaste, yeh meri awaaz hai. Main voice identity system test kar raha hoon.
Hello yaar, this is same voice speaking both languages naturally.
